description: Dedicated editing source set for the full mock.

passage:
Workshop Registration Notice

The technology workshop begin at 10 a.m. and participants must brings a charged laptop. Check-in will open at 9:30 outside the second-floor design studio. A staff member will confirm each registration and provide a table number. Participants who cannot bring a laptop may request a loaner on the registration form, but the number of loaners is limited.

The instructors has prepared three short activities: coding a sensor, testing a circuit and to record the results. Each activity builds on the one before it, so participants should plan to attend the entire session. Printed instructions will be available, and the same files can be downloaded from the workshop page. Anyone who need an adapter should request one before Friday.

The room is on the second floor, it is beside the design studio. Use the east elevator or the stairs near the main entrance. Directional signs will be posted in the lobby and at the elevator. If you need step-free access from the parking area, follow the blue signs to the east entrance.

Because seats are limited, consequently registrations will close when thirty names are received. A waiting list will open automatically after the workshop fills. If a registered participant cancels, the first person on the list will receive an email and will have twenty-four hours to accept the seat. Please cancel promptly if your plans change.

Participants should save their work often and asks questions when instructions are unclear. Two assistants will circulate during the activities, and a separate help table will be available for equipment problems. Food is not permitted near the circuit kits, but closed water bottles may be kept on the side counter.

Each table will share a sensor kit, so label your team's files with the assigned table number. Workshop staff will erase the loaner laptops after the session. Copy any project you want to keep to your own storage before returning a device.

At the end, each team will upload their file review the checklist, and then they should submit a reflection. The upload folder will close at 2:30 p.m. Instructors will remain for thirty minutes afterward to answer questions about continuing the project at home. Completion certificates will be emailed the following week to participants who submit all three items.
